verbatim_text: This standard governs how customer contact staff and automated agents communicate with subscribers about account status, billing, and service changes.
heading: CC-1 Scope

verbatim_text: Subscriber means any person holding an active or lapsed service account, including a former subscriber whose final bill remains open.
heading: CC-1.1 Subscriber defined

verbatim_text: Contact window means the period between 09:00 and 20:00 in the subscriber's registered local time zone on any weekday, and between 10:00 and 17:00 on a Saturday. No contact window exists on a Sunday or a public holiday.
heading: CC-1.2 Contact window defined

verbatim_text: An agent must not initiate contact with a subscriber outside the contact window defined in CC-1.2, except where the subscriber has expressly requested a call at a stated time.
heading: CC-2.1 Timing of outbound contact

verbatim_text: An agent must not contact a subscriber more than three times in any seven day period regarding the same open matter. Contact attempts that do not connect are excluded from this count.
heading: CC-2.2 Contact frequency

verbatim_text: Where a subscriber states that they do not wish to be contacted again about a matter, the agent must record the request and must not initiate further contact about that matter, except to confirm the request has been recorded.
heading: CC-2.3 Contact suppression

verbatim_text: An agent must state the charge amount exactly as it appears on the subscriber's most recent statement. An agent must not quote an estimated, rounded, or projected amount as though it were the billed amount.
heading: CC-3.1 Accuracy of billed amounts

verbatim_text: Where a subscriber disputes a charge, the agent must suspend collection activity on the disputed amount until the dispute is resolved and the outcome has been communicated in writing.
heading: CC-3.2 Disputed charges

verbatim_text: A dispute is resolved when the agent has sent the subscriber a written outcome that states the amount upheld, the amount removed, and the reasoning.
heading: CC-3.3 Resolution of a dispute

verbatim_text: An agent must not promise a credit, refund, or waiver that the agent is not authorised to grant. Authorisation limits are set out in the agent's role profile.
heading: CC-4.1 Unauthorised commitments

verbatim_text: An agent must not state or imply that a service will be disconnected on a specific date unless a disconnection notice for that date has already been issued.
heading: CC-4.2 Disconnection statements

verbatim_text: An agent may offer a payment arrangement within the limits set out in the agent's role profile, and must state the total payable and the number of instalments.
heading: CC-4.3 Payment arrangements

verbatim_text: At the start of every outbound call, the agent must identify the company by its registered trading name and state the purpose of the call.
heading: CC-5.1 Identification at call opening

verbatim_text: An agent must not discuss the details of a subscriber's account with any person other than the subscriber or a person the subscriber has authorised in writing.
heading: CC-5.2 Third party disclosure

verbatim_text: Recordings of customer contact calls must be retained for twenty four months from the date of the call and must be made available to the subscriber on request.
heading: CC-5.3 Call recording retention
